# PyTorch Distributed Training Troubleshooting

When a multi-GPU training job hangs indefinitely, follow this diagnostic checklist:

- First, identify the master node. Do not restart worker nodes before checking the master node's log files.
- If the master node is unresponsive, terminate all backend processes on the host. Run `killall python` immediately on all worker nodes.

- Never ignore socket binding errors; you must resolve any interface conflicts before starting a new run.
